name: researchzy-reading
description: Read papers with your agent: lawful full-text downloads, a close reading of one paper, and structured Paper Cards. Works on your own PDFs; no account needed.

interface.shortDescription: Download full text, read papers closely and build Paper Cards.
interface.longDescription: Download full text through open access or your own publisher API keys, read one paper closely (design choices, worked formulas, how far the evidence reaches) and create evidence-grounded Paper Cards. Works on the PDFs you give it; no Researchzy account needed.
interface.defaultPrompt: Read this paper closely: why did the authors design it this way, and how far does the evidence reach?
